probes.detail: Manifest lists [A,B,C]. Verifying with each of A, B, C returns exactly that projection (not the first or last listed), with manifest digest, open order, bytes and role unchanged; a single-schema manifest returns its value. Unlisted projections D, zero, 0xff.., the manifest digest and the asset digest all refuse Incompatible after opening only the manifest, with no bundle. Verifying the same source and pin under A and then C gives separate bundles with distinct projections and identical bytes; completeness is unaffected.

After success, clearing and replacing the source and dropping it leaves bundle bytes, their heap address (no re-read), path and projection unchanged. An aliasing source that serves identical bytes from another backing name is accepted with the manifest path retained, which is the declared trusted-source boundary. That alias source with its target missing refuses Io. Same-length different bytes refuse Digest. A reader that fails after 5 bytes refuses Io after opening [manifest, asset]. A missing manifest refuses Io with only the manifest opened. No partial bundle or projection is exposed on any failure.

An external test crate compiles *b.projection_sha256() (control). Constructing VerifiedBundle or VerifiedAsset fails E0451. Reading the private projection_sha256 field fails E0616. Assigning through projection_sha256() or manifest_sha256(), or mutating asset bytes, fails E0594. Cloning a bundle fails E0308 because VerifiedBundle is not Clone.

Review01 filesystem probes on the unchanged platform code: symlink at each depth, dangling/loop/file-parent/long-name, FIFO and /dev refusal, hardlink write-through caught, case alias admitted at load but refused by exact completeness (TMPDIR case-insensitive: true), retained root survives real-directory substitution, and bounded concurrent swaps returning zero outside bytes (parent ok/refused 4760/17263, leaf 5731/9545; naive path reads saw outside bytes 5698/6158 times).

invalidatedRuns.reason: The first review02 runs copied the pristine tree preserving old mtimes, so cargo reused stale builds of files mutated by the previous mutant: platform failures appeared on lib-only mutants, and a root failure on the platform-only P08 in probes mode. These results are quarantined and not relied on. The driver was corrected and all three modes were re-run on fresh target dirs.
invalidatedRuns.review01Impact: Review01's driver shared this weakness, but only restorations were stale; every mutated file carried a fresh mtime. Its recorded outcomes are corroborated here: the 12 survivors reproduce in 'original' mode, and the kills reproduce in 'final' mode.

advisories.title: Projection accessor test does not pin which listed digest is retained
advisories.detail: Mutants that store the first or last listed schema digest instead of the checked projection (N03, N04) survive the permanent tests, because the only projection assertion uses a single-schema manifest and the multi-schema loop asserts only is_ok. The implementation is correct (it stores *projection after the membership check). Adding assert_eq!(bundle.projection_sha256(), &p) for a middle element of a three-entry list, as in D-PROJ, would close this gap. It is not a defect, and it matters mainly before the compiled-schema join relies on the field.

advisories.title: UNIT.md keeps superseded sentences
advisories.detail: 'Seven unit groups cover ...', 'Actual independent Claude review is pending', and a run instruction without the platform test command remain in the historical text. The appended trial02 paragraph corrects them. Label them historical or refresh them when next edited.

advisories.title: Flags test leaves its temp directory on failure
advisories.detail: tests/file_flags.rs uses a PID-named directory with strict create_dir and cleans it up only on success. Induced failures here left review-flags-<pid> directories behind. A later run that recycles the PID in the same TMPDIR would fail at create_dir rather than on the flag. Use a drop guard or a unique suffix.

advisories.title: Review01 filesystem probes were not adopted
advisories.detail: That was not required by RQ-1. They still pass on the unchanged adapter (R01-FS). Their case-alias observation remains an input to the pending portable alias policy.

advisories.title: Unchanged, acknowledged adapter behaviour
advisories.detail: O_NONBLOCK remains set on returned regular files, and a device leaf's open routine can run before fstat refuses it. Both are stated in UNIT.md and stay within the trusted installation root.

advisories.title: Completeness is projection-agnostic
advisories.detail: Two bundles verified under different projections pass the same completeness enumeration. This is correct for this owner. The final renderer must still join projection_sha256 to its compiled selected projection.
